## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta8

### Simplify visual editor color labels
- Remove the extra left-side color-name prefixes added in beta7.
- Keep only Home Assistant's native small floating label above each color swatch, matching the clean `Trail color` and `Channel color` appearance.
- Apply the same native-only label treatment to **Custom area color**.
- Preserve the beta6 **Custom areas** / **Colors** grouping, native color picker behavior and existing stored values.

Scheduler, current-cycle trail, mower rendering and performance behavior are unchanged.
